in_marathi.name: Sentu
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Mountains
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sentu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sentu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sen', which means 'Lord'. The suffix 'tu' is added to denote 'Mountains'. Hence, the name Sentu means 'Lord of the Mountains'.

in_bengali.name: Sentu
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of the Mountains
in_bengali.long_meaning: Sentu একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The name Sentu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sen', which means 'Lord'. The suffix 'tu' is added to denote 'Mountains'. Hence, the name Sentu means 'Lord of the Mountains'.
